definitions.explanation: Describing something done poorly or lacking skill. A formal, somewhat literary term used to criticize the quality of work, performance, or technique.

examples.japanese: {拙劣|せつれつ}な⟦{演技|えんぎ}→演技：01890_engi⟧だった。
{拙劣|せつれつ}な⟦{模倣|もほう}→模倣：15752_mohou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧すぎない。
examples.english: It's nothing more than a crude imitation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{拙劣|せつれつ}な⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{拡大|かくだい}→拡大：02553_kakudai⟧⟦させた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The government's poor handling of the situation worsened the damage.

notes: Composed of {拙|せつ} (clumsy, unskillful) + {劣|れつ} (inferior). A formal/written term expressing strong criticism of quality or skill. The opposite is ⟦{巧妙|こうみょう}→巧妙：07933_koumyou⟧ (skillful, clever). Common collocations: {拙劣|せつれつ}な⟦{手口|てぐち}→手口：12756_teguchi⟧ (clumsy tactics), {拙劣|せつれつ}な⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧ (poor technique), {拙劣|せつれつ}な⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧ (poor handling). More formal and harsher than ⟦{下手|へた}→下手：00703_heta⟧ (unskillful, poor at). Related words: ⟦{稚拙|ちせつ}→稚拙：09062_chisetsu⟧ (immature, childish — implies lack of sophistication), ⟦{粗雑|そざつ}→粗雑：09209_sozatsu⟧ (rough, sloppy).
